ef_house_c_widow: Sixty-one years in this building. Four floors, and I have not once been cold in it.
My husband was a pourer. He was warm the whole of his life, and it did not make it a long one.
ef_house_c_lodger: I came here from Stonewake. Quarry town, cold as the inside of a hole.
Here the floor is warm and the rent is double, and I am not going back.
